mom_settings.intro:
Group Final Quiz 1 — Instructions

This is a collaborative group test. Work with your assigned group to discuss and solve each problem together. Every student must submit their own answers individually on their own device.

Topics covered (Weeks 1–6):

  • Week 1 — Linear Functions (§1.1–1.5): Function notation and evaluation, domain and range, average rate of change, slope from two points, linear graph interpretation, modeling with linear functions, best-fit-line and residuals
  • Week 2 — Intro to Matrices (§2.1–2.2): Solve a 2-equation linear system algebraically
  • Week 3 — Systems of Linear Equations and Matrices (§2.3): 3x3 system via row reduction (RREF)
  • Week 4 — Inverse Matrices (§2.4): 2x2 system via the inverse matrix method
  • Week 5 — Linear Inequalities: Solve a linear inequality with sign-flip awareness
  • Week 6 — Linear Programming Applications (§3.1–3.2): Graphical LP corner evaluation, LP problem formulation (objective + constraints)

Group work rules:

  • Discuss first, submit individually. Talk through each problem as a group before anyone submits.
  • Everyone participates. Make sure every group member understands the reasoning before moving on.
  • Three attempts, no penalty. You get 3 tries with the same version. Use them if your group wants to re-check a problem.
  • Stay with your group. Do not leave the classroom or break off from your group until everyone has submitted.

Your individual submission will be graded, but your score reflects your group's collective effort. Work together and make it count.
